cloudvisuals.gui.no_images: The folder is empty — put PNG files there and press Open below
cloudvisuals.gui.tooltip.row: Click — settings · Right click — toggle · Middle click — bind
cloudvisuals.module.profiles.description: Save sets of settings, load them and share a code
cloudvisuals.profiles.copy: Copy a code of current settings
cloudvisuals.profiles.copied_hint: Send it to a friend — they paste it on their side
cloudvisuals.profiles.paste: Paste a code from the clipboard
cloudvisuals.profiles.import_failed: No Cloud Visuals code in the clipboard
cloudvisuals.onboarding.1.title: Sections
cloudvisuals.onboarding.1.text: All Cloud Visuals features live here. Switch tabs with the mouse or the left and right arrows.
cloudvisuals.onboarding.2.title: Search
cloudvisuals.onboarding.2.text: Press Ctrl+F or just start typing — I will find any module or a single setting.
cloudvisuals.onboarding.3.title: Modules
cloudvisuals.onboarding.3.text: Click opens settings, the switch turns a module on. Right click on a row toggles it too, middle click binds a key, the star adds to favorites.
cloudvisuals.module.server_warning.descr: Warns on FunTime, ReallyWorld and HolyWorld, where visuals are allowed by whitelist only
cloudvisuals.module.watermark.descriptio: Name, FPS, ping, time and server
cloudvisuals.notify.welcome.title: Cloud Visuals %s
cloudvisuals.notify.welcome.subtitle: Visuals are ready
cloudvisuals.character.line.4: Ctrl+F and I'll find any setting
cloudvisuals.warning.whitelist.title: %s: visuals by whitelist only
cloudvisuals.warning.whitelist.subtitle: Cloud Visuals is not approved there yet — ban risk
cloudvisuals.module.hud.description: Editor, grid, ready-made layouts and element behavior
cloudvisuals.module.hud.open_editor.desc: Drag elements with the mouse, resize with the wheel. This module's key opens the editor too
cloudvisuals.module.hud.snap.description: Elements snap to the edges, the screen center and each other. Hold Alt to move freely
cloudvisuals.module.hud.grid.description: Show a grid in the editor and align elements to it
cloudvisuals.module.hud.layout_focus: Focus — key info near the crosshair
cloudvisuals.module.hud.hide_debug.descr: Elements fade out while the debug screen is open
cloudvisuals.module.hud.animations.descr: Elements spring in and out, size and position change smoothly
cloudvisuals.hud.editor.title: HUD editor
cloudvisuals.hud.editor.hint: Drag to move · wheel to resize · Alt to move freely · Ctrl+Z to undo
cloudvisuals.hud.editor.empty_hint: Press “Elements” below and turn on the ones you need
cloudvisuals.gui.tooltip.hud_editor: Move HUD elements with the mouse
Each line gets its own plate; turn off for one shared panel
cloudvisuals.module.keybinds.description: Modules with keys and their state
cloudvisuals.hud.keybinds.title: Keybinds
cloudvisuals.module.target_hud.descripti: Target card: health, armor and held item
cloudvisuals.module.target_hud.crosshair: Also show whoever you look at, not only whoever you hit
cloudvisuals.module.target_hud.model.des: Mobs get a tiny live model instead of an icon
cloudvisuals.module.potions.description: Potions with a time ring, level and timer
cloudvisuals.module.potions.hide_vanilla: Remove the default effect icons in the top right corner
cloudvisuals.module.armor.description: Your armor durability as bars and percent
cloudvisuals.module.inventory.descriptio: Preview of your inventory on screen
cloudvisuals.module.coordinates.descript: Position, facing, biome and Nether conversion
cloudvisuals.module.compass.description: Cardinal direction bar at the top
cloudvisuals.module.warnings.description: Armor or tool running out, effect ending
cloudvisuals.module.fps.description: Frames per second with a mini graph
cloudvisuals.module.ping.description: Server latency with a mini graph
cloudvisuals.module.session.description: How long you have been playing on this server or world
cloudvisuals.module.glass_hotbar.descrip: Liquid glass hotbar with a flowing slot selection
cloudvisuals.module.glass_tab.descriptio: Player list on a liquid glass panel
cloudvisuals.module.glass_scoreboard.des: Server sidebar on a glass panel
cloudvisuals.module.glass_bossbar.descri: Boss and server event bars on glass
cloudvisuals.module.titles.description: Big on-screen titles appear with a soft pop
cloudvisuals.module.fullbright.descripti: See in the dark. Does not remove blindness or darkness
cloudvisuals.module.camera.description: Hurt shake, view bobbing and field of view
cloudvisuals.module.camera.dynamic_fov: FOV change from sprint and bow
cloudvisuals.module.time_weather.descrip: Your own time of day and weather — only on your screen
cloudvisuals.module.sky.description: Aurora, light rays, twinkling and shooting stars, floating cubes, custom sky and fog colors
cloudvisuals.module.particles.descriptio: Fewer particles — cleaner screen and more FPS
cloudvisuals.module.entity_colors.descri: Hurt tint color and enchantment glint color
cloudvisuals.module.crosshair.descriptio: Custom crosshair: shape, size, color and hit marker
cloudvisuals.module.hand.description: Position, rotation, size and swing animations in first person — per hand
cloudvisuals.module.hit_effects.descript: Stars, hearts, sparks, claw slashes and a flash on the target when your hit lands. Only you see them
cloudvisuals.module.block_outline.descri: The block you aim at: outline, full fill, glass with a sheen, aura with lights, corners or marching dashes
cloudvisuals.module.trajectories.descrip: Flight path of your own arrows, trident, pearls and potions
cloudvisuals.module.nametags.description: Nametag size, background and shadow; your own name in F5
cloudvisuals.module.chat.description: Smooth messages, timestamps, merged repeats and glass
cloudvisuals.module.item_physics.descrip: Dropped items lie flat and tumble in the air
cloudvisuals.module.hats.description: China hat, halo, crown, horns, ears or top hat — only you see it (F5)
cloudvisuals.module.wings.description: Angel, demon, butterfly, crystal or light wings — with a skeleton and living flaps
cloudvisuals.module.aura.description: Ring, waves, orbiting lights, helix, sparks or light pillars around you
cloudvisuals.module.cape.description: Theme gradient or your own picture — only you see it
cloudvisuals.module.trail.description: Ribbon, line, dots, helix or sparks behind you — length in seconds, any colors
cloudvisuals.module.jump_circles.descrip: Circles on the ground when you jump or land: ring, waves, dashes, hexagon or star
cloudvisuals.module.pet.description: A king, cat, little dragon, ghost, bee, slime or a glowing wisp by your side — visible in first person too
cloudvisuals.module.screens.description: Title screen, pause menu, loading and server list in Cloud Visuals style
cloudvisuals.section.title: Title screen
cloudvisuals.module.screens.glass_button: Buttons and sliders in every menu made of liquid glass (except inventories)
cloudvisuals.module.screens.title: New title screen
cloudvisuals.module.screens.title.descri: Buttons with icons on the left, Cloud Visuals header instead of the logo
cloudvisuals.module.screens.title_player: A 3D model of your skin that turns towards the cursor
cloudvisuals.module.screens.title_whats_: A card with the version highlights — once closed, it returns with the next version
cloudvisuals.module.screens.title_splash: Minecraft's random phrase under the MINEE header
cloudvisuals.module.screens.pause.descri: Buttons with icons, quick access to Cloud Visuals and the HUD editor
cloudvisuals.module.screens.pause_info.d: A capsule with the server or world name, ping, players and play time
cloudvisuals.module.screens.loading.desc: A liquid droplet instead of the Mojang logo that fills up while loading
cloudvisuals.module.screens.status.descr: A glass card while connecting, loading, saving and after disconnecting
Glass cards and favorites: the star moves a server to the top
cloudvisuals.screens.whats_new.1: New screens: title, pause, loading and connecting
cloudvisuals.screens.whats_new.2: Glass buttons and sliders in every menu
cloudvisuals.screens.whats_new.3: Favorite servers and ping in numbers
cloudvisuals.screens.whats_new.4: Cosmetics: wings, pet, capes and trails
cloudvisuals.screens.favorite: Add to favorites — the server moves to the top
cloudvisuals.screens.whitelist: Visual mods are allowed on %s only by whitelist
cloudvisuals.module.sounds.description: Interface sound pack and volume per category
cloudvisuals.module.theme.font_file.desc: TTF or OTF from the config/cloudvisuals/fonts folder
cloudvisuals.gui.no_files: The folder is empty — put files there and they will show up here
cloudvisuals.themes.copied_hint: Send it to a friend — they can paste it on this page
cloudvisuals.themes.import_failed: That's not a Cloud Visuals theme code
cloudvisuals.module.clickgui.background_: PNG or JPG from the config/cloudvisuals/backgrounds folder
On the title screen and in menus
The picture replaces the Minecraft panorama in every menu
cloudvisuals.module.clickgui.edit_rig.de: Mark the head, tails and eyes with the mouse to bring the character to life
cloudvisuals.rig.title: Skeleton editor
cloudvisuals.rig.tool.head: Head
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.head: Click the center of the head and drag — that's its radius. The head turns towards the cursor.
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.neck: Click where the neck is: the head rotates around this point.
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.breath: Drag from the shoulders down to the waist — this part will breathe.
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.tail: Drag from the root of a tail to its tip. Right click removes the nearest one.
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.eye: Draw a box around an eye — it will blink. Right click removes it.
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.hair: Click the hair: Cloud Visuals uses its color to find what should sway.
cloudvisuals.rig.hint.exclude: Draw a box around what must not move (hands, items). Right click removes it.
cloudvisuals.server_profiles.choose: Which profile to enable — click to pick another
cloudvisuals.module.performance.descript: Low-end PC mode, a hint on low FPS and system info
cloudvisuals.module.performance.lite.des: Glass without blur and screen captures — the menu and HUD barely load the GPU
If the game struggles for half a minute, Cloud Visuals suggests the light mode
cloudvisuals.module.performance.text_bat: Labels are drawn in batches so the menu is faster. Turn off if text ends up in the wrong place with other mods
cloudvisuals.module.performance.diagnost: GPU, driver and mods copied to the clipboard for a bug report
cloudvisuals.performance.suggest.title: The game struggles: %s FPS
cloudvisuals.performance.suggest.subtitl: Turn on “Low-end PC mode” in Cloud Visuals → Performance
cloudvisuals.crash.disabled: Cloud Visuals turned off “%s” after a game crash
cloudvisuals.crash.unknown: The game crashed because of a Cloud Visuals error
cloudvisuals.module.notifications.update: On launch Cloud Visuals checks whether a new version is out (once the mod is published)
cloudvisuals.update.title: Cloud Visuals %s is out
cloudvisuals.update.subtitle: Download it where you got the mod
cloudvisuals.menu.no_settings: This module has no settings — just turn it on or off.
cloudvisuals.menu.hud_editor.tip: Drag HUD elements around the screen
cloudvisuals.menu.no_favorites: Nothing here yet. Open a module and press "Favorite".
cloudvisuals.menu.empty: No modules in this category yet.
cloudvisuals.menu.mouse_hint: LMB toggle · RMB settings · MMB key
cloudvisuals.menu.mouse_hint.full:
Left mouse button — turn a module on or off.
Right — open its settings without toggling.
Middle (wheel) — bind a key.
Arrows ↑↓ — next module, Space — toggle.
cloudvisuals.menu.key_hint: Click, then press a key. Esc or Backspace clears. Right click clears at once.
cloudvisuals.menu.reset.tip: Restore all module settings to defaults
cloudvisuals.menu.hint.left: Left click a module — toggle it
cloudvisuals.module.clickgui.reset_windo: Drag the window by its top bar and resize it by the bottom right corner
cloudvisuals.module.clickgui.menu_blur.d: Off by default: the menu opens right over the game
cloudvisuals.menu.search.tip: Just start typing — search opens by itself. Ctrl+F
cloudvisuals.menu.row_tip.toggle: LMB toggle · RMB settings · wheel click key
cloudvisuals.module.clickgui.glass_densi: Lower is clearer, higher is darker and easier to read
cloudvisuals.module.hand.preset.descript: Click to change the main hand at once. Fine-tune with sliders afterwards
cloudvisuals.module.hand.main_z.descript: Negative moves it away from the camera
cloudvisuals.module.hand.swing_speed.des: Animation only: attack speed stays the same
cloudvisuals.module.hand.spin.descriptio: The item slowly spins in your hand. 0 — no spin
cloudvisuals.cosmetic.colors.description: Theme colors, your own color, a 2–3 color gradient or rainbow. Colors can flow
cloudvisuals.cosmetic.life.description: The piece breathes, drifts on the air and sways when you jerk. 0 — still and even, 100 — alive
cloudvisuals.module.trail.height.descrip: 0 — at the feet, 50 — waist, 100 — above the head
cloudvisuals.module.hit_sounds.descripti: Your own sound when your hit lands, separate ones for crits and kills. Only you hear them
cloudvisuals.module.hit_sounds.pitch_spr: Every hit sounds slightly different so it never gets boring
cloudvisuals.module.hit_sounds.open_fold: Put files into config/cloudvisuals/sounds — they appear in the sound lists
cloudvisuals.module.event_sounds.descrip: Totem, low health, death, joining a server and level up
cloudvisuals.module.event_sounds.open_fo: Put files into config/cloudvisuals/sounds — they appear in the sound lists
cloudvisuals.module.music.description: What plays in Spotify or on YouTube: cover, title, artist and equalizer. Pause and skip tracks with keys
cloudvisuals.module.keystrokes.descripti: W A S D, mouse buttons with CPS and space — pressed keys light up
cloudvisuals.module.item_counter.descrip: How many totems, golden apples, pearls and more you carry — from your inventory
cloudvisuals.module.film_effects.descrip: Vignette, film grain, letterbox bars and a color filter
cloudvisuals.module.ambient_particles.de: Sakura petals, snow, embers, leaves or bubbles around you
cloudvisuals.module.kill_effects.descrip: Where your target died: light lightning, souls, a shockwave, confetti or a flash
cloudvisuals.module.sky.rays: Light rays from the moon and sun
cloudvisuals.module.sky.nebula.descripti: A wide ragged band across the whole sky, like the Milky Way. Slowly shifts
cloudvisuals.module.sky.black_hole.descr: A dark disc with a burning ring across it and light bent over and under it. Only you see it
cloudvisuals.module.afterimage.descripti: On a jump, landing, sprint or hit a copy of you stays in the same pose and evaporates
cloudvisuals.hud.placement.edit_position: Opens the HUD editor on this element: drag it anywhere, resize with the wheel or the corners
cloudvisuals.hud.placement.reset_positio: Back to its place and normal size
cloudvisuals.module.screens.inventory: Glass inventory, chests and crafting table
cloudvisuals.module.bloom.description: A soft glowing halo for the aura, trails, hit particles, wings, pets and block highlight — like in shaders. Walls hide it, the hand and the interface stay clean
cloudvisuals.module.looks.description: A complete style for the whole client in one click: colors, sky, combat effects, cosmetics
cloudvisuals.look.intro: A look enables the right modules and tunes them to one style. You can adjust any detail afterwards, or recolor everything at once by changing the accent in Theme.
cloudvisuals.look.applied.hint: Any detail can be adjusted in the module settings
cloudvisuals.look.signature.description: Signature: stars on hit, glass block highlight, night aurora, the king pet
cloudvisuals.look.blood.description: Red sky with cubes, energy surge, claw slashes, lightning on kills, demon wings
cloudvisuals.look.polar.description: Violet and teal aurora, snow, stars on hit, souls, wings of light
cloudvisuals.look.sakura.description: Pink sky, petals, hearts on hit, confetti, butterfly wings, a cat
cloudvisuals.look.space.description: Black sky with a nebula, crystals on hit, orbit, hologram echo
cloudvisuals.look.clean.description: For combat: nothing extra, just hit sparks, a jump ring and a block outline
cloudvisuals.module.swing_trail.descript: A glowing arc follows the blade when you swing and fades in a fraction of a second. First person, only you see it
cloudvisuals.module.swing_trail.width: How much of the blade glows
cloudvisuals.module.zoom.description: Hold the key and the camera zooms in smoothly. The wheel changes the power, the mouse gets gentler meanwhile
cloudvisuals.module.zoom.wheel: Change power with the mouse wheel
cloudvisuals.module.aspect_ratio.descrip: Stretched screen: the world is drawn as if the screen had another shape. The interface stays normal
cloudvisuals.module.block_info.descripti: The name of the block you aim at and the tool to mine it. Never shows container contents
cloudvisuals.module.item_locks.descripti: Lock a slot and the item in it can't be dropped with Q, neither in hand nor in the inventory. Hover a slot and press the lock key
cloudvisuals.item_locks.blocked.hint: Unlock: press the lock key over the slot in the inventory
cloudvisuals.module.container_search.des: A search field above chests, shulkers and the inventory: matching items are highlighted, the rest are dimmed
cloudvisuals.module.waypoints.descriptio: Your death point is marked automatically, your own marks with a key. A light beam, a name and the distance; visible from afar. Only places are marked, never players
cloudvisuals.module.waypoints.remove_key: Key: remove the mark I look at
cloudvisuals.module.waypoints.clear: Remove all marks of this world
cloudvisuals.waypoints.name: Mark %s
cloudvisuals.waypoints.added.hint: Remove it with the key or in the settings
cloudvisuals.module.item_glow.descriptio: A soft colored halo around the item in your hand, following its outline. First person, only you see it. Needs Effect Glow turned on
cloudvisuals.module.island.description: A live capsule at the top center, like the Dynamic Island: time and FPS, music, stopwatch, victories. Notifications grow right out of it
cloudvisuals.module.chunk_fade.descripti: A freshly loaded piece of the world softly fades in instead of popping. Nothing moves — only transparency changes
cloudvisuals.module.self_view.descriptio: In first person you can see your own body: look down and you see your chest, legs and armor. The head is not drawn
cloudvisuals.module.keys.description: Every Cloud Visuals hotkey in one list: see what is taken and rebind it right here
cloudvisuals.keys.intro: Click the key on the right and press a new one. Right-click it to clear. The game's own keys are changed in its control settings.
cloudvisuals.module.target_esp.descripti: Flying rings and sparks around your target
cloudvisuals.module.free_look.descriptio: Hold the key to look around without turning your head
cloudvisuals.module.music_lyrics.descrip: 3D song lyrics in the world, synced with your music
